paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, providing a comparison of performance trends on "BBQ" task. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500 and tick labels at intervals of 250 demonstrations. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", with a linear scale ranging from 45 to 55, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The dark blue line, representing the "Squared Exponential" model with solid lines and circle markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 52 at 0 demonstrations, increases till above 55 at 250 and remains steady with slight variations. The blue line, representing the "Tanh" model with solid lines and circle markers, begins at about 48 accuracy at 0 demonstrations and remains mostly constant throughout. The light purple line, "ELU" model, also shown with solid lines and circle markers, starts at about 46 accuracy and shows little change. The dashed magenta line with no markers represents the "LLmA-2-chat-7B" model, starting and maintaining an accuracy of 43 across all demonstration points. No lines intersect each other. A legend is given top right describing the line and color.
